name: Fireplace
description: A crackling fire in a stone fireplace: animated flames, rising sparks, flickering firelight on the stone, glowing logs, a mantel with the time.

steps.script: const n = project.elements.length; ['Hour','Colon','Minute'].forEach((nm,i)=>{ project.elements[n-3+i].name = nm + ' Aod'; }); return 1
